sections.title: PICK YOUR ROLES
sections.body:
Press a button, the role is yours. Press it again to drop it. Only you see the replies.

──────────────────────────────

fields.name: Unit
fields.value: One or the other. Switching moves your role and your record with it.

fields.name: Region
fields.value: Where you play from, so ops can be timed around the roster.
